$comment: Cross-lesson source registry (D041-D043). Seeded by P12 (M0 release); every content plan APPENDS its lesson's sources here, never rewrites an existing entry. `id` is a stable kebab-case key; `verified_at` is the date a human or /verify-sources actually fetched the URL - do not copy one forward without refetching. `lang` is the language of the SOURCE document, omitted when it is English. Lesson frontmatter stays the authority for what a given lesson renders; this file is the shared index the meta/03 sources page and /verify-sources read.
